tasks.task: Before the daily 09:00 UTC support standup, verify that the active production observability cluster context named "prod-eu-west1-gke:observability" is reachable and that the "monitoring" namespace has running workloads by (1) resolving the context from the registry, (2) listing namespaces, and (3) listing Pods in the context’s default namespace (monitoring).

success_criteria: Step 1 returns at least one context and $0.contexts.0.context_name equals "prod-eu-west1-gke:observability".
Step 2 returns a namespaces list that includes "monitoring" (the context’s default namespace).
Step 3 returns a Pod list in namespace "monitoring" (items array exists; ideally length > 0).
